blurb: Guests can join guided kayak tours exploring local rivers and wildlife, including the Nickajack Bat Cave, downtown Chattanooga bridges, Tennessee River Gorge fall colors, and Sandhill Crane winter tours. Mountain bike rentals are available with delivery and pickup options, offering a range of full suspension and hardtail bikes for local trail systems. Tours are beginner and family friendly, with all necessary equipment provided.
